verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Medusa exposing itself as an MCP server (docs-4, docs-33, probe-rt-1) so AI tools can query its docs — the reverse of this story, which asks whether Medusa can consume external MCP servers and use their tools. No documentation or probe shows Medusa's 'Cloud Development Agent' or admin/backend can be configured to plug in external MCP servers as a client.
